name: Joining The Local Church
overview: Scripture reveals that the local church is a divinely established body with Christ as its head, built upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets as a spiritual community that cannot be overcome by evil. Believers are called to unite as members of one body, each with distinct roles, and to faithfully gather together for mutual encouragement and growth. The church is precious to God, purchased by the blood of Christ, and overseen by appointed leaders who shepherd the flock. Joining the local church is both a response to God’s design and a vital part of the believer’s spiritual life.
